    14→def _is_chinese_char(cp: int):
    15→    """Checks whether CP is the codepoint of a CJK character."""
    16→    # This defines a "chinese character" as anything in the CJK Unicode block:
    17→    #   https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CJK_Unified_Ideographs_(Unicode_block)
    18→    #
    19→    # Note that the CJK Unicode block is NOT all Japanese and Korean characters,
    20→    # despite its name. The modern Korean Hangul alphabet is a different block,
    21→    # as is Japanese Hiragana and Katakana. Those alphabets are used to write
    22→    # space-separated words, so they are not treated specially and handled
    23→    # like the all of the other languages.
    24→    if (
    25→        (cp >= 0x4E00 and cp <= 0x9FFF)
    26→        or (cp >= 0x3400 and cp <= 0x4DBF)  #
    27→        or (cp >= 0x20000 and cp <= 0x2A6DF)  #
    28→        or (cp >= 0x2A700 and cp <= 0x2B73F)  #
    29→        or (cp >= 0x2B740 and cp <= 0x2B81F)  #
    30→        or (cp >= 0x2B820 and cp <= 0x2CEAF)  #
    31→        or (cp >= 0xF900 and cp <= 0xFAFF)
    32→        or (cp >= 0x2F800 and cp <= 0x2FA1F)  #
    33→    ):  #
    34→        return True
    35→
    36→    return False

    39→def find_printable_text(text: str):
    40→    """Returns the longest printable substring of text that contains only entire words."""
    41→    # Borrowed from https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/061580c82c2db1de9139528243e105953793f7a2/src/transformers/generation/streamers.py#L99
    42→
    43→    # After the symbol for a new line, we flush the cache.
    44→    if text.endswith("\n"):
    45→        return text
    46→    # If the last token is a CJK character, we print the characters.
    47→    elif len(text) > 0 and _is_chinese_char(ord(text[-1])):
    48→        return text
    49→    # Otherwise if the penultimate token is a CJK character, we print the characters except for the last one.
    50→    elif len(text) > 1 and _is_chinese_char(ord(text[-2])):
    51→        return text[:-1]
    52→    # Otherwise, prints until the last space char (simple heuristic to avoid printing incomplete words,
    53→    # which may change with the subsequent token -- there are probably smarter ways to do this!)
    54→    else:

    71→        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
    72→        self.eos_token_id = self.tokenizer.eos_token_id

    75→        read_ids: List[List[int]] = []
    76→        surr_ids: List[List[int]] = []
    77→        for msg in msgs:
    78→            if msg.uid not in self.decode_map:
    79→                self.decode_map[msg.uid] = DecodeStatus(
    80→                    decoded_ids=[],
    81→                    decoded_str="",
    82→                    read_offset=0,
    83→                    surr_offset=0,
    84→                    sent_offset=0,
    85→                )
    86→            s = self.decode_map[msg.uid]
    87→            if not (msg.finished and msg.next_token == self.eos_token_id):
    88→                s.decoded_ids.append(msg.next_token)
    89→            read_ids.append(s.decoded_ids[s.surr_offset :])
    90→            surr_ids.append(s.decoded_ids[s.surr_offset : s.read_offset])
    91→
    92→        read_texts = self.tokenizer.batch_decode(read_ids)
    93→        surr_texts = self.tokenizer.batch_decode(surr_ids)
    94→
    95→        incremental_strs: List[str] = []
    96→        for msg, read_str, surr_str in zip(msgs, read_texts, surr_texts, strict=True):
    97→            s = self.decode_map[msg.uid]
    98→            new_text = read_str[len(surr_str) :]
    99→            # Streaming chunk: update the decode status
   100→            if len(new_text) > 0 and not new_text.endswith("�"):
   101→                output_str = s.decoded_str + new_text
   102→                s.decoded_str = output_str
   103→                s.surr_offset = s.read_offset
   104→                s.read_offset = len(s.decoded_ids)
   105→            else:
   106→                new_text = find_printable_text(new_text)
   107→                output_str = s.decoded_str + new_text
   108→
   109→            incremental_output = output_str[s.sent_offset :]
   110→            s.sent_offset = len(output_str)
   111→            incremental_strs.append(incremental_output)
   112→            if msg.finished:
   113→                del self.decode_map[msg.uid]
   114→
